name: Поля й захист від зв’язки
description:
As in the previous lesson, we are going to defend against a special attack. In this lesson we defend against the pin.

Material loss can again be prevented by attacking a mating square (see the example).

What do you have to do?

Avoid a loss of material by counterattacking a mating square.

examples.text: The knight on d2 is attacked twice and only covered once. Removing the pawn is not a good idea, because then the rook on d1 drops. Yet with 1.Ra1! white has salvation. Black captures the knight and 2.Ra8+ follows. After interposing with the rook, black is mated on the next move. If black makes luft then white has time to remove the knight: 1...f6 2.Nf3. Because the rook is no longer on d1, the knight is no longer pinned!

texts: Create a counterplay. Look at the white king.
